summary: Created vg_data/lv_data on node1, mounted it at /srv/data, and grew it online from 1 GiB to 2 GiB (2,147,483,648 bytes). The mount remained active and file hashes stayed unchanged. Persistence was verified after reboot.
actions_performed: Created a persistent loop-backed LVM PV, VG, and LV.
Formatted the LV as ext4 and mounted it at /srv/data.
Created test content and recorded SHA-256 hashes.
Extended the mounted LV and filesystem online to 2 GiB.
Enabled an OpenRC service for boot-time activation and mounting.
Rebooted node1 and verified full recovery.

evidence.requirement: Logical volume mounted at /srv/data with content
evidence.summary: Created the 1 GiB LV, mounted ext4 at /srv/data, and recorded test-file hashes.

evidence.requirement: Grow to at least 2 GB while mounted with contents intact
evidence.summary: LV reached 2,147,483,648 bytes; mount ID remained 36 during online resize and the binary payload hash was unchanged.

Captured healthy baseline, acknowledged reboot, proved boot ID changed from 93232348-dcc7-42e7-bb95-ccae4ec54530 to e38e5b54-158c-4555-8a9a-b11890cac9af, and verified the 2 GiB LV, mount, service, and original file hashes recovered.
